name: Upload
usage: Attachments of a form, importing a file, uploading images

props.name: accept
props.description:
Accepted file types: comma-separated extensions and MIME types, such as `".pdf,image/png,image/*"`. Checked
for chosen and dropped files; rejected files are not added to the list and `onReject` is called. By default
every type is accepted.

props.name: maxSize
props.description:
Maximum size of one file in bytes, such as `10 * 1024 * 1024` for 10 MB. Larger files are not added to the list
and `onReject` is called. There is no limit by default; the server must check the size as well.

props.name: onReject
props.description:
Called for each file rejected by `accept` (`reason` is `type`) or `maxSize` (`size`), for example to show a
message.

props.name: customRequest
props.description:
Sends a file: report the progress and the result with the callbacks in `options`. Return an object with
`abort()` to let "Remove" cancel the request. Without `customRequest` and `action`, files are only added to the
list.

props.name: action
props.description: Address that receives each file as a `multipart/form-data` POST, when `customRequest` is not given.

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the file field in the POST to `action`.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allows choosing several files at once.

props.name: maxCount
props.description: Largest number of files in the list; with `1`, a new file replaces the old one.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables choosing and removing files.

props.name: fileList
props.description: The files in the list (controlled).

props.name: defaultFileList
props.description: Initial files (uncontrolled), such as attachments already saved.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when files are added, change state or are removed.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called before a file is removed; return `false` (or a promise of it) to keep it.

props.name: onPreview
props.description: Called when the name of a file in the list is clicked, such as to preview it.

props.name: showUploadList
props.description: Shows the file list below the trigger: name, size or progress, "Retry" for failed files and "Remove".

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger, usually a Button. Pressing it opens the file dialog; focus stays on it.

props.name: testId
props.description:
Test id, rendered as `data-testid` on the hidden file input, where tests set the files to upload (such as
Playwright's `setInputFiles`).

members.name: Upload.Dropzone
members.summary:
A drop area instead of a trigger button: files can be dragged onto it, or chosen by clicking it or pressing
`Enter` / `Space`. It shows an icon, `title` and `hint` (or your own `children`), and the text changes to "Drop
to add the files" while files are dragged over it. Takes the same props as Upload (requests, `accept`, `maxSize`,
the file list); use it for imports and attachment areas where dragging is common.

props.name: title
props.description: Main text of the drop area; the built-in text by default ("Drag files here, or click to choose").

props.name: hint
props.description: Secondary text below the title, such as the accepted types and the size limit.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom content that replaces the icon, title and hint.

props.name: testId
props.description:
Test id, rendered as `data-testid` on the hidden file input, where tests set the files to upload (such as
Playwright's `setInputFiles`).

types.name: UploadRejectReason
types.summary: Why a file was rejected: `type` does not match `accept`, `size` exceeds `maxSize`.

types.name: UploadRequestOptions
types.summary: What `customRequest` receives: the file and the callbacks that report progress and the result.

fields.name: onSuccess
fields.description: Reports success, with what the server returned; the file becomes `done`.

fields.name: onError
fields.description: Reports failure; the file shows "Upload failed" and "Retry".

types.name: UploadFile
types.summary: A file in the list of Upload.

fields.name: uid
fields.description: Unique id of the file in the list.

fields.name: response
fields.description: What the request reported with `onSuccess`, such as the id from the server.

fields.name: originFileObj
fields.description: The chosen file (not present for files of `defaultFileList`).

fields.name: url
fields.description: Address of the uploaded file: the name in the list becomes a link that opens it in a new tab.

types.name: UploadChangeInfo
types.summary: What `onChange` receives: the file that changed and the whole list after the change.

fields.name: fileList
fields.description: The whole list after the change.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
Upload does not send requests by itself: here `customRequest` uploads the file and reports progress. Set `accept`
and `maxSize` (there are no defaults, so every type and size would be accepted) and tell the user about rejected
files in `onReject`.

examples.name: Dropzone
examples.title: Drop area
examples.description:
`Upload.Dropzone` accepts files dragged onto it, and opens the file dialog on click or `Enter` / `Space`. Put the
accepted types and the size limit in `hint`.

examples.name: Retry
examples.title: Failed uploads and retry
examples.description:
A failed file shows "Upload failed" and a "Retry" button that sends the same request again; here the first
attempt of every file fails. Files that failed before the page was loaded (without a request to repeat) can only
be removed.

examples.name: WithoutRequest
examples.title: Files for a form
examples.description:
Without `action` and `customRequest`, nothing is sent: chosen files are only added to the list, and the form
sends them on submit. `disabled` hides "Remove" and does not open the dialog.

examples.name: Preview
examples.title: Previewing files
examples.description:
`onPreview` makes the file names buttons; here they open the uploaded files in FilePreview, read from the
device (`originFileObj`) before they are uploaded, or from their address (`url`).
